exitCodes.meaning: The human approved or amended; the payload is the review reply. Amend is not a rejection — its editedPatch carries the edited patch.
Invalid arguments — missing --wait, no selector, both a range and --staged, or a malformed --timeout.
The Switchyard app is not running. Review never launches the app.
The request was superseded by a newer review for the same repository, or the app could not serve it — no decision was received.
The app quit before the human decided — never reported as a decision.
The human rejected the review; the payload still carries the full reply with ok:true.
No decision arrived within --timeout — a typed timeout outcome, never a rejection and never an app failure.

flags.help: Review the staged changes (HEAD against the index) instead of a range.
Give up the wait after this many seconds (default 3600). On expiry the CLI exits 10 with a typed timeout outcome — never a rejection.
Block until the human decides. Required in this build; a non-blocking form does not exist yet.

summary: Push a diff to the app and block until the human decides, returning the decision as structured data.
